description.la: De arca Noe morali, in quattuor libris: arca cordis ad aedificandam sapientiae domum.
description.en-US: Hugh’s Moral Ark of Noah, in four books: the ark as the heart and the Church built by wisdom, a meditation on the interior life told to his brethren. Latin only, from the Migne text (Patrologia Latina 176, 1854), a machine-corrected OCR.
description.pt-BR: A Arca moral de Noé de Hugo, em quatro livros: a arca como o coração e a Igreja edificados pela sabedoria, uma meditação sobre a vida interior.

sources.edition: Migne, Patrologia Latina 176 (Paris 1854); TEI XML of the Corpus Corporum (University of Zurich), text HuDeSVi.DeArNoM, from the machine-corrected OCR of the Open Greek and Latin project.
sources.description: The complete PL text with its chapter divisions. PL page breaks and column numbers are dropped, and the PL tables of chapters (which repeat the chapter headings) are not imported. The OCR carries a few residual slips.
sources.tierEvidence: Migne’s Patrologia Latina (1854–1855) prints the medieval text; public domain everywhere.
